comments.headline: Integrated Pest Management restrictive covenant not recorded
comments.summary: The required IPM restrictive covenant for the biofiltration facility has not been recorded with Travis County, leaving the cover sheet IPM reference (Sheet 1, Block 12) blank. No evidence exists that the covenant has been submitted to City Law Department for review and approval prior to recordation.
comments.crossDep: City Law Department (covenant approval and recordation); Watershed Protection Department (water quality requirements)

details.text: IPM restrictive covenant has not been recorded with Travis County. Cover sheet Block 12 (Sheet 1) displays blank document number ('For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________'). No evidence of City Law Department approval and county recordation has been provided.

runComments.comment: Restrictive covenant for Integrated Pest Management (IPM) plan required for biofiltration pond facility has not been recorded. Cover sheet Block 12 shows blank document number for IPM covenant ('For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________'). The recorded IPM restrictive covenant document number must be completed and updated on the cover sheet, and evidence of City Law Department approval and county recordation must be provided.

Integrated Pest Management (IPM) restrictive covenant required for the biofiltration/detention pond has not been demonstrated as submitted to City Law Department for review and written approval prior to recordation. Water Quality review comment WQ 12 indicates the IPM plan is pending submission; no evidence of covenant submittal to City Law is provided.

details.text: The executed, notarized IPM restrictive covenant document (as approved by City Law Department) has not been provided for review. The application lacks the covenant document, exhibits, lien search, affidavit of title, and consents required for recordation.

runComments.comment: Restrictive covenant form and completeness cannot be verified; the IPM covenant document is not recorded (blank document number on cover sheet). Submit the executed, notarized IPM restrictive covenant (approved by City Law Department) and evidence of county recordation to verify compliance with form and content requirements.

IPM restrictive covenant in the form approved by City Law Department has not been provided. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains a blank document number field, and no covenant document with exhibits, lien search, affidavit, or consents has been submitted for review.

comments.headline: Easements not properly depicted or documented on site plan
comments.summary: Multiple recorded easements are missing, illegibly labeled, or identified with incorrect document numbers on the site plan. Proposed easements are not distinctly marked as 'proposed.' Easement documentation required for legal approval has not been submitted to City Legal Department for review.
comments.crossDep: City Law Department (easement document review); Watershed Protection Department (drainage easement coordination)
comments.attn: Verify that corrected easement depiction (especially City of Austin Drainage Easement, Instrument 2011021137) does not conflict with detention pond location. Cross-reference with 24:ZLU-24.45 for conflict resolution.

details.text: City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner, perpetual) required for drainage facilities is not depicted on any drainage or site plan sheet despite County records confirming its existence. The easement must be clearly delineated showing location, boundaries, and recording information.

runComments.comment: The City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, NE corner, 0.130 acres, perpetual) required for drainage facilities is not depicted on the drainage or site plan sheets. County records and applicant communication confirm this easement exists and affects the property. The easement must be clearly delineated on site plan showing its location, boundaries, and recording information to demonstrate that development does not conflict with City's right to access and maintain the drainage facility.

details.text: Two recorded easements are misidentified: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement shown with incorrect document number (2010070273 displayed vs. recorded 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior); (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (2011021137) not depicted at all. Correct identification and location of all existing recorded easements affecting the property must be provided.

runComments.comment: Two critical existing recorded easements are not properly identified on the site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (recorded Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior no-build zone) is mislocated and shown with incorrect document number (2010070273); (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (recorded Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner) is not depicted at all. County records confirm both are perpetual easements encumbering the property. Provide correct identification and location of all existing recorded easements affecting the property.

details.text: Multiple easement document numbers on site plan sheets are cut off, obscured, or illegible, including Wastewater Easement, Sidewalk Easements (two locations), and Water Line Vault Easement (western boundary). Greenbelt Access & Use Easement shows apparently transposed document number. Proposed easements lack 'PROPOSED' labels and show blank document number fields ('Doc# _______').

runComments.comment: Several easements on the site plan have document numbers that are cut off, obscured, or illegible, including Wastewater Easement, Sidewalk Easement (two locations), and Existing Water Line Vault Easement on the western boundary. Additionally, the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement is labeled with an apparently transposed document number (2010070273 shown vs. recorded 2010070731). All easements must be clearly labeled with legible, accurate recording information showing document number and volume/page or instrument number. Revise to ensure all easement labels are complete, legible, and accurate.

Proposed easements (wastewater and sidewalk easements shown on site plan) are not clearly designated with 'proposed' labels; instead, they show blank document numbers ('Doc# _______'). All proposed easements must be explicitly labeled as 'PROPOSED' on site plan sheets to distinguish them from recorded (existing) easements, which must show recording information (volume/page or document number).

details.text: Drainage easement documents for the 25-foot drainage easement and City of Austin Drainage Easement have not been submitted to City Legal Department for review and approval prior to recordation. Drainage Engineering review comment DE 3 (Pending status) requests the drainage easement document, indicating non-submission.

runComments.comment: Drainage easement documents for the 25-foot drainage easement and City of Austin drainage easement shown on the site plan have not been demonstrated as submitted to City Legal Department for review and approval prior to recordation. Drainage Engineering review comment DE 3 (Pending status) specifically requests 'Please provide the drainage easement document' indicating the document has not been provided.

comments.headline: Proposed improvements conflict with recorded easement restrictions
comments.summary: The proposed biofiltration/detention pond and associated improvements are sited within two recorded easements that restrict or prohibit development: the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (perpetual no-build zone, NE interior) and the City of Austin Drainage Easement. No easement modification, vacation, or compatibility documentation has been provided.
comments.crossDep: City Law Department (easement modification/vacation authorization); Watershed Protection Department (drainage easement coordination); applicant's legal counsel (easement analysis)
comments.attn: Verify current detention pond layout against recorded easement boundaries (Greenbelt Access & Use, Instrument 2010070731; City Drainage, Instrument 2011021137). Determine whether pond can be relocated entirely outside easement areas or whether easement modification/coordination is required.

details.text: Proposed biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, and associated improvements (NE interior area) are located within the recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, perpetual no-build zone, 0.31 acres). Additionally, pond facility is located partially within City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, NE corner), which reserves unlimited City rights to construct, operate, and maintain drainage infrastructure. No easement vacation, release, modification, or City coordination documentation has been provided.

runComments.comment: Proposed biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, and associated improvements are located in the NE interior area where the recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, perpetual no-build zone) exists. No documentation of easement vacation, release, or modification authorizing these improvements within the easement boundaries has been provided. The proposed development is not compatible with a perpetual no-build easement without formal easement modification or vacation.

Biofiltration/detention pond facility is located partially within the existing recorded City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, NE corner). The easement grant document reserves unlimited rights for City to construct, operate, and maintain drainage infrastructure; any on-site improvements require City (Watershed Protection Department) coordination and approval. Evidence of City coordination and approval for pond location within easement must be provided; alternatively, demonstrate that pond layout avoids the easement area entirely.

details.text: No evidence provided that applicant has reviewed the recorded Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, perpetual no-build zone, 0.31 acres, NE interior) terms to determine compatibility with proposed biofiltration/detention pond and other improvements in this area. Evidence of easement review and confirmation that proposed improvements comply with the no-build restriction must be provided.

runComments.comment: The Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) is recorded as a perpetual no-build zone covering 0.31 acres in the NE interior. The site plan shows biofiltration/detention pond, retaining walls, BBQ area, and other improvements in this same NE interior area, but it cannot be verified from available documents whether applicant has reviewed the recorded easement terms to determine compatibility with the proposed development in this area. Provide evidence of easement review and confirmation that proposed improvements do not violate the no-build restriction.

comments.headline: Cover sheet missing legal instrument documentation
comments.summary: The cover sheet lacks a comprehensive inventory identifying the status, location, and document numbers for all required or proposed legal instruments (recorded easements, proposed easements, restrictive covenants, drainage easements, license agreements). Additionally, inappropriate multi-lot or cohesive development notes appear on a single-lot site cover sheet.
comments.attn: Confirm whether multi-lot or cohesive development provisions actually apply to this single-lot site. If not, remove from cover sheet. Verify that legal instrument inventory is complete, accurate, and includes all recorded easements, proposed easements, and restrictive covenants identified elsewhere on plan.

details.text: Single-lot site cover sheet includes multi-lot or cohesive development notes that do not apply to this property. These notes must be removed or clarified to accurately reflect single-lot development status.

runComments.comment: Single-lot site should not include multi-lot or cohesive development notes. If such notes are present on the cover sheet, they must be removed or clarified to reflect single-lot status.

details.text: Comprehensive inventory of all required or proposed legal instruments is not clearly identified and listed on cover sheet or in comment response letter. Provide consolidated table or note on cover sheet identifying status (recorded/proposed), location on plan sheets, and document numbers for all legal instruments, including recorded easements (Greenbelt, Drainage, Sidewalk, Wastewater), proposed easements, drainage easements, and restrictive covenants (IPM).

runComments.comment: A comprehensive inventory of all required or proposed legal instruments (recorded easements, proposed easements, drainage easement documents, restrictive covenants, license agreements) is not clearly identified and listed on the site plan cover sheet or in the comment response letter. Provide a consolidated table or note on the cover sheet identifying the status, location, and document numbers for all legal instruments required for the project.

Required legal instrument (IPM restrictive covenant for biofiltration pond) not properly identified and listed on site plan or in comment response letter. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains the template text 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas' but the document number field is blank, indicating the required legal instrument is not complete or identified.
